/code-review.note: Review the current diff, at the level you used last time
Pick the effort level, from a few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain. Target: a PR number, a branch or a path
Deep multi-agent review in the cloud. Billed, and only you can launch it
Apply the findings to the working tree after the review
Post the findings as inline PR comments
Report up to n findings, or all of them; the choice sticks until you pass default
ultra on a GitHub.com PR: post the finished review as one comment, or hide that option

/loop.note: Repeat on a fixed interval, e.g. /loop 5m /foo
No interval: Claude picks the pace itself

overlaps.title: Pull request review
overlaps.note: Several ways to review a PR. The built-in /code-review and the code-review plugin do the same job; the toolkit adds specialised agents (tests, silent failures, types); /review is gstack's version. Keep the ones you use.

overlaps.title: Simplifying code
overlaps.note: The built-in /simplify and the code-simplifier agents cover the same ground. One of them is usually enough.

overlaps.title: Writing skills
overlaps.note: Several guides for authoring skills. Pick one.

overlaps.title: Driving a browser
overlaps.note: Chrome extension, the desktop app's built-in browser and gstack's own Chromium. They drive different browsers, so they only overlap if you never use one of them.
